official_definition: You can send the 20px from your Field/Trash to this Spirit. If you've done so, refresh this Spirit. You can only use Soul Awaken once per turn.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Soul Awaken] or [Soul Awaken: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Soul Awaken]", "give [Soul Awaken]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Transitions state from EXHAUSTED to REFRESHED.
